# DemoBook 14 SE（演示版）产品事实

> SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: the confusable SIBLING of DemoBook 14. Some values differ on purpose
> (weight, battery, CPU, refresh rate, ports) so tests can catch sibling-value leaks.
